name: assertify
description: Let Claude use any website you're logged in to. Log in once; the session stays encrypted on your machine.
long_description: Assertify gives Claude a real browser that is already logged in as you. You sign in once in a normal browser window (2FA, passkeys and SSO all work), and the session is saved AES-256-GCM encrypted with a key in your OS keychain. Claude can then open headless, logged-in sessions to read, click, type and take screenshots. Each login is locked to its own domains. Nothing is uploaded anywhere: there is no server, no account and no telemetry.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List saved website logins (name, start URL, allowed domains, last updated).

tools.name: start_login
tools.description: Open a visible browser window so the USER can log in to a site by hand.

tools.name: complete_login
tools.description: Save the logged-in session from the login window (encrypted) and close the window.

tools.name: delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a saved login from disk.

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Open a headless browser already logged in as the saved profile. Returns a session id and page snapshot.

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close a session. With save=True (default), refreshed cookies are written back to the vault.

tools.name: save_session
tools.description: Write the session's current cookies/storage back to the encrypted vault.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Current URL, title and a list of interactive elements with [eN] refs to use in other tools.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Go to a URL (must be within the profile's allowed domains).

tools.name: back
tools.description: Browser back button.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click the element with the given ref (e.g. "e12") from the latest snapshot.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Replace the contents of a text field with `text`. submit=True presses Enter afterwards.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose an option (by visible label or value) in a <select> element.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the page, e.g. "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "Control+A".

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page "up" or "down" by `amount` pixels (lazy-loaded content appears in the next snapshot).

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until `text` appears on the page (up to 15s), or just wait `seconds`.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Return the visible text of the page (for reading content, tables, messages, etc.).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the current page, or just one element (ref from the latest snapshot).

tools.name: set_screenshots
tools.description: Turn per-step screenshots on or off for a session (each action then returns a screenshot).

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Make tab `index` (0-based) the active tab. New tabs/popups become active automatically.
